name: frankfurter-mcp
description: Frankfurter (exchange rates) (market data): search_symbols, get_series. Every tool maps to a documen

platform_mcp_frankfurter_base_currency.title: PLATFORM_MCP_FRANKFURTER_BASE_CURRENCY
platform_mcp_frankfurter_base_currency.description: ISO 4217 base currency for get_series (the API's `base`, default EUR per the spec).

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: Searches the currency list (GET /currencies: every active currency with its name, e.g. 'dollar', 'yen' or 'USD'); the API has no search parameter, so the server filters code and name locally (case-insensitive substring) and pages the matches. `raw` has iso_numeric, the local symbol and start_date/end_date.

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: series_id is the quote currency (ISO 4217, e.g. USD); values are units of it per 1 base currency (config base_currency, default EUR). start/end are YYYY-MM-DD; without them the API returns the latest rate only. One record per date (daily).
